name: Angelic Grace
description: When any phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army has a mortal wound allocated to it, target that unit. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.

name: Armour of Contempt
description: When your opponent's Shooting or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of that unit's attacks. Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of attacks that target your unit by 1.

name: Savage Echoes
description: When your opponent's Charge phase, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that was just charged. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to the Strength or Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. Alternatively, give in to the Red Thirst: the unit becomes Battle-shocked, but both characteristics are increased by 1.

name: Red Rampage
description: When the Fight phase, target one Adeptus Astartes unit from your army that has not been selected to fight. Until the end of the phase, its melee weapons have [LANCE] or [LETHAL HITS]. Alternatively, give in to the Red Thirst: the unit becomes Battle-shocked, but its melee weapons have both abilities.

name: Aggressive Onslaught
description: When your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army has Advanced, target that unit. Until the end of the turn, it is eligible to shoot or declare a charge. Alternatively, give in to the Red Thirst: it becomes Battle-shocked, but is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge.

name: Relentless Assault
description: When your Movement phase, just after an Adeptus Astartes unit from your army Falls Back, target that unit. Until the end of the turn, it is eligible to shoot or declare a charge. Alternatively, give in to the Red Thirst: it becomes Battle-shocked, but is eligible to both shoot and declare a charge.
